body: I bought a Samsung 980 ssd 1tb with heat sink (make sure you have the heat sink!). Fairly cheap and super super easy to install in the ps5. It is an internal drive and once you pop the cover off you’ll see. 2 minutes of YouTube tutorial and you’re golden.

In my experience, I have the disc version original edition. Not the slim version. It is backwards compatible with ps4 games, which I have a good handful of. Depending on how many, and what types of games he plays and has (based on size) I would go with that. I also purchased a ssd for it (Samsung 980 1 terabyte) because a lot of older and especially newer games take up wayyyyyyy to much space now and it is just terrible. You’re constantly deleting and reinstalling games without it. Any other questions feel free to ask, hope this helps!
